subject: Export proof & deletion certification for audit logs - Finvero
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@finvero.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Audit evidence: export formats, retention & proof-of-deletion

Hi Sean / Kimberly,

We are starting our external audit for FY26 and the auditors are requesting a couple of concrete things related to audit/access logs for our Redwood tenancy:

- Canonical formats you can export (prefer newline-delimited JSON, Parquet or CSV) and support for compressed bundles.
- Ability to schedule regular exports (monthly or on-demand) and an SLA for making an export available.
- For our regulator we need 7-year retention for specific audit streams and an auditable chain of custody when logs leave Redwood.
- A signed deletion certificate once logs are purged at the end of retention, and confirmation that all backups/replicas and cached KV are also removed (we need assurances and a timeline).

Attaching a short requirements doc the auditors gave us. Can you confirm which of this is supported for hosted tenants vs. Dedicated/Private deployments? Also please call out any additional contractual controls you’d require (e.g., export location, encryption requirements, contact for chain-of-custody).

Thanks,
Oliver
Finvero - Head of IT Security

Attachment: finvero_audit_requirements_202612.pdf
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@finvero.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Audit evidence: export formats, retention & proof-of-deletion

Oliver — thanks for the doc, this is exactly the right time to lock down the flow before the auditors start in January. High level answers below; I’ve outlined steps we can take depending on whether you’re on Hosted, Dedicated, or Private.

Summary of export capabilities (supported today):
- Formats: newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON), Parquet, CSV. Large exports are packaged as tar.gz or zip.
- Delivery: secure SFTP drop, direct push to your S3 bucket (cross-account role), or time-limited presigned HTTPS URL.
- Encryption: exports are encrypted in transit (SFTP/TLS) and at-rest. For cross-account S3 we use server-side encryption with customer-managed keys (CMKs) when requested.
- Automation: scheduled monthly snapshots or on-demand exports via Console/Api; we can also run weekly exports for a given log stream.

Retention & deletion:
- Hosted: default audit/access log retention is 90 days. For audits we provide ad-hoc long-term exports. We can store exported snapshots for you as a hosted object for up to 1 year by agreement.
- Dedicated/Private: retention can be configured to meet regulatory needs (e.g., 7 years). In Private deployments you control KMS and storage buckets so you get stronger contractual assurances.
- Deletion process: soft-delete window (30 days) -> background purge (up to 180 days) for archived blobs on Hosted unless contractually committed otherwise. For Dedicated/Private we can offer deterministic purge windows aligned with contract.

Proof-of-export & chain-of-custody options we can provide:
- Export manifest (CSV) with file list, object sizes, and SHA256 checksums.
- Signed manifest: we can PGP-sign or timestamp via our signing service.
- Access ledger: immutable audit events (who initiated export, IPs, S3 access events) included in the package.
- Transfer receipts: SFTP/HTTP logs and S3 object metadata with upload timestamps.

Proof-of-deletion options:
- We can produce a signed deletion certificate (PDF) that lists manifests and hashes of deleted objects, plus the purge timestamps.
- For Dedicated/Private customers we can include a KMS key destruction attestation if keys are rotated/destroyed per agreement.
- Note on backups: Hosted backups may reside in managed snapshots for operational resilience. For contractual retention/purge we can exclude snapshots from your retention window or provide a contractual SLA to purge snapshots — requires Dedicated/Enterprise contract terms.

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm whether Finvero will be on Hosted or if you plan to move to Dedicated/Private before your audit?
2) If you need 7-year retention on Hosted we’ll estimate storage/costs and required contract addenda.
3) We’ll schedule a 30-45 minute tech call to walk through export manifest format and sign-off on the chain-of-custody process.

I’ve attached a sample export manifest and flagged items that need your input. If this looks good, Kim (cc’d) can confirm the compliance deliverables and timelines.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com

Attachment: audit_export_manifest_202612.csv
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@finvero.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, security@finvero.com
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 08:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Audit evidence: export formats, retention & proof-of-deletion

Thanks Sean — very helpful. A few clarifying questions before we loop procurement:

1) Cross-region residency: our auditors require that the authoritative export for EU data be created and delivered from an EU region (to avoid transferring protected personal data to the US). Can you guarantee the export originates in an EU region and that any intermediate replication doesn’t copy the set outside the EU?

2) Backup/replica purge: when you issue a deletion certificate, does that cover all internal replicas, KV caches, and snapshot stores? We need a description of the purge lifecycle and maximum time-to-purge once a deletion is requested under contract.

3) Export SLA: would 48 hours for on-demand exports be feasible? For scheduled monthly exports we’d like a 24-hour delivery window after snapshot completion.

4) Manifest details: we prefer a SHA256 checksum per file and a top-level package checksum. Also want the export to include an event-level access log for the same period (who viewed/queried logs) — is that included or separate?

If you can confirm the above, procurement will prepare a change order.

—Oliver

Attachment: finvero_audit_requirements_202612.pdf (attached again with inline notes)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@finvero.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Dec 2026 11:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Audit evidence: export formats, retention & proof-of-deletion

Oliver — great questions. Short answers and commitments we can make under an enterprise amendment: 

1) Cross-region exports: yes. For tenants with EU residency we can pin export jobs to an EU region (e.g., eu-central-1). Exports will be created and signed inside the region; we will not copy or stage the raw export objects outside the EU unless explicitly authorized. We also offer an option to have the export directly written into a customer-controlled EU S3 bucket via cross-account role.

2) Backup & replica purge: under Hosted default operational backups may persist beyond the tenant’s soft-delete window as part of platform resilience. For an enterprise contract we will add a purge SLA: soft-delete window (up to 30 days) -> forced purge of primary objects within 30 days after soft-delete -> replica/snapshot purge within 90 days (max). If you require stricter timelines we can negotiate Dedicated/Private terms where we provide deterministic purge windows (e.g., immediate snapshot lifecycle deletion configured to 0 days). We will include a purge lifecycle diagram in the change order.

3) Export SLA: 48 hours for on-demand exports is feasible as a contractual SLA; 24 hours for scheduled monthly snapshots is also acceptable. We’ll need to carve out extreme load/force majeure exceptions and include an acceptance test during onboarding.

4) Manifest & event-level logs: we will provide a manifest with per-file SHA256 and a top-level package SHA256. The export bundle will include the event-level access logs for the same retention period (this is an optional export stream; we’ll enable it for your tenant if requested).

Proof-of-deletion deliverables we’ll include in the addendum:
- Signed deletion certificate (PDF) listing manifests, SHA256s, purge timestamps and the scope of objects removed.
- Chain-of-custody bundle: signed manifest, S3 transfer receipts or SFTP server logs, and our audit event ledger entries showing the export and deletion operations.
- Optional notarization: we can arrange third-party timestamping (RFC 3161) for manifests upon request.

Final notes:
- For Hosted tenants who need 7-year retention we typically recommend exporting to customer-controlled storage (your S3) and then Redwood will perform lifecycle operations per contract to avoid keeping long-term copies in our backup systems.
- I’ll create SUP-4821 to track the contract amendment and the engineering work for an EU-pinned export path. Marissa — please coordinate a calendar for a technical handoff; we should include our infra lead to validate the S3 cross-account role and KMS key policy.

Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Related: JIRA SUP-4821, https://redwood.example.com/drive/retention-patterns/finvero-guidance
